Hi Alicia / Samir —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — useful to hear how Northbridge is thinking about edge inference for device telemetry and where you expect most of the latency/cost sensitivity to show up. Quick recap of the outcomes I took away:

- Goal: validate a short pilot to run inference at the fleet edge (device -> regional GPU) for anomaly detection and trimming false positives
- Success criteria: sub-150ms tail latency for priority workflows, <10% uplift in per-request cost compared to cloud-only baseline, and clear audit logs for model inputs/outputs
- Risks: EHR integration scheduling, and security approvals for inbound telemetry (Samir flagged both)

Next step: 30-minute product preview (compact demo + ops handoff) to align on architecture assumptions and nominate owners for a mutual action plan. I propose three candidate 30-minute windows (all PT):

1) Tue 2026-11-02 — 10:00–10:30 PT (primary)
2) Wed 2026-11-03 — 13:00–13:30 PT (east coast friendly)
3) Thu 2026-11-04 — 11:00–11:30 PT (backup)

Please let me know which slot works best and who from your side should join (I recommend Product, Infra, and Security). I've attached a draft mutual action plan + my call notes so we can capture owners immediately.

If none of those hit, share two 30-min options and I'll adjust.

Thanks — I’ll hold the primary slot tentatively until I hear back.

Best,
Mina Haddad
